scope: Review of a user-supplied public-source compilation; not a runnable scenario. Verified means source transcription, not physical validation. Original input is preserved unchanged.
verdict: Partially fills nominal station spacing and adds historical context. Does not resolve wheel-force/power curves, resistance/inertia, full segment geometry, electrical parameters or independent validation observations.

nominal_gilmore_betty_spacing_m.locator: Line 2 System row Gilmore - Betty Go-Belmonte
nominal_gilmore_betty_spacing_m.applicability: Published nominal spacing; publication date and reference endpoints not stated
nominal_gilmore_betty_spacing_m.limitation: Not direction-specific stopping-mark distance or surveyed chainage; no complete route profile

nominal_supply_voltage_v.applicability: Historical original LRT-2 four-car train documented 2011
nominal_supply_voltage_v.limitation: Nominal DC rating; not measured voltage or an electrical power/efficiency limit

new_wheel_diameter_m.limitation: Not operating wheel condition; insufficient for force inference without torque/gearing

worn_wheel_diameter_m.locator: Table 3.6-2 PDF 160: literal English label Worm 790; interpreted as worn wheel
worn_wheel_diameter_m.limitation: Not a measured current wheel condition

reported_train_km_2010.limitation: No matched interstation trajectory or loading/control context

reported_electricity_2010_j.locator: Table 3.4-6 PDF 142 / printed 3-24: 27600237 kWh multiplied by 3600000 J/kWh
reported_electricity_2010_j.limitation: Meter boundary unspecified; do not calibrate train-terminal energy or infer auxiliary/traction efficiency

aggregate_j_per_train_km_2010.limitation: Boundary differs from or is not known to match the simulator; not a calibration target

qualification_corrections: Performance loading is unspecified in the English summary but the already-reviewed Japanese edition Table 3.6-2 PDF 179 establishes AW3; preserve that stronger qualification.
The already-reviewed Japanese edition establishes one-hour duty for 120 kW per motor. Motor count and aggregate wheel power remain unresolved.
Zero grades at Gilmore and Betty are historical inferences from elevated-station categories in PDF 122, not a flat interstation profile or equal station elevations.
175180 kg AW1 is consistent with 232 seated passengers at 65 kg, but these are loading conventions rather than observed masses.
227050 kg AW2 follows 1030 passengers; 1026 implies 226790 kg. Retain the existing conflict and exclude AW2 from active scenarios.
The conditional 16 * 120 kW = 1.92 MW shaft total is arithmetically correct. Its sixteen-motor premise has no recovered primary source here and must not replace wheel power.
unresolved_simulator_inputs: wheel traction force versus speed and applicable wheel power
service and regenerative brake envelopes and low-speed behavior
whole-train resistance and equivalent rotating inertia
rail-level segment profile and direction-specific stopping marks
actual regenerative acceptance and metered energy boundary
independent time/speed/distance and energy validation observations
active_scenario_changes_from_scrape: None; public context is retained separately from hypothetical solver inputs.
